paragraphs: Levi bar Nezira, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 2 of Berakhot. But that account in Jerusalem Talmud, Shekalim, has Shimon bar Nezira; so too Yevamot (97) has Shimon Nezira in this account. Thus Levi is a scribal error.
